title: Mother with Children Outside Greenhouse, 1950s Black & White Vintage Snapshot Ph
description: A black and white vintage snapshot capturing a mother posing with her daughter and young son on a lawn outside, circa 1950. A large glass greenhouse or conservatory is visible in the background past the trimmed hedges. The family wears typical mid-century clothing, with the young boy dressed in a striped polo and shorts while his sister wears a dark striped dress.
